programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As if Gargamel didn't have enough troubles as it is. Now he is saddled with a new problem, a problem by the name of Scruple, a new apprentice. A lazy, insolent, good-for-nothing character who will help in getting hold of the enchanted quill, a magic pen that writes nothing but the truth... and is going, or so Gargamel hopes, to aid in catching the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy doesn't always do as he is told. For instance, he is a little careless in putting out the campfire where the Smurfs have been roasting marshmallows. Even though the Smurfs are doing the impossible in trying to save the forest from the holocaust, the situation looks bleak. Snappy is hunted by remorse. And he would be even more so if he knew what the evil Gargamel is up to.

programme.title: Can't Smurf The Music
programme.desc: There is nothing the sorceress Chlorhydris hates so much as love in the world. She would like to see all love banished from the face of the Earth, and she's going to start with music. She puts a spell on a magic horn so that it will suck the music out of every song... especially the Smurfs' songs. Helped by their friend Laconia, the Smurfs may be able to resist Chlorhydris' evil plan...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel has got hold of magical ectoplasmic crystal eggs that will enable him to change bodies with Papa Smurf. What better plan could there be? Disguised as Papa Smurf, he's going to lead all the Smurfs to his cauldron! But as fate would have it, Gargamel is changed into Puppy, the Smurf doggie...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's not every day you meet a talking flower. Especially not a character like Petaluma, a somewhat haughty bulb flower who Smurfette meets in the forest. Of course the delighted Smurfette takes Petaluma to the Village of the Smurfs... and starts a process that is going to endanger all of the Smurfs. Flowers, it seems, ought to be seen and not heard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everybody can make a mistake. Take Papa Smurf, for instance. His new perfume-enhancing spray makes a rose smell like a thousand roses...but due to a whole series of misadventures it also makes all the Smurfs cry, moved to tears by the slightest of pretexts. While they sob, bawl, wail moan and whimper, the evil wizard Gargamel does not stand still...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Tonight is talent show night in the Village of the Smurfs. Grandpa Smurf is going to do magic tricks, Sassette is going to perform with her trained pet frog, Clumsy is going to try his hand at juggling... and Jokey Smurf has made a dummy of Gargamel that he is sure will frighten the Smurfs out of their wits. But the real Gargamel finds a way to animate Jokey's dummy and then...

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Baby Smurf has lost all interest in toys. Even Jokey's surprises fail to amuse the tiny tyke. Grandpa Smurf suggests they go and pay a visit to the Toymaker, the one who makes toys for children all over the world. Or rather used to make: the Toymaker is tired of the lack of appreciation his toys receive from those who receive them.

programme.title: Handy's Window-Vision
programme.desc: Miner Smurf leaves no stone unturned and this is how he discovers a crystal that transmits images. Thus Handy is able to invent window-vision and, every morning from then on, the Smurfs are able to watch Hefty's workouts, Farmer Smurf's crop reports or even the Brainy Smurf Hour. But would you believe it? The evil wizard Gargamel takes advantage of this image-watching to catch Smurfs!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf has been elected Wizard of the Year, and the evil wizard Gargamel is beside himself with jealousy. He will see to it that Papa's powers all disappear. And then, he is sure to catch all the Smurfs and celebrate with a big feast... But now, would Papa Smurf let such a bad thing happen? Surely not, Papa finds a way to foil Gargamel's plan...

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sweepy the chimney sweep Smurf is not the most popular inhabitant of the Village of the Smurfs. He is rather messy, and the clouds of soot that he makes certainly don't add to his popularity. Only the Smurflings find him great company as he's the only one who can get dirty and not be told off. Yet in their enthusiasm for Sweepy, the Smurflings endanger the Village.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is in the box that's been found by Jokey Smurf? A cloak belonging to Wizlow the Magician gnome. And what sort of cloak? Jokey learns that it's a cloak of invisibility. Whoever wears it has a great opportunity of playing practical jokes... And guess what havoc an invisible Jokey is able to wreak on the Village. Yet if Wizlow parted with the cloak, there must be a reason...

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf is aghast. Sassette cannot read, and thus might be forever prevented from learning the pearls of wisdom collected in his book "Brainy Smurf's quotations"! He tries teaching her how to read. What she can read almost from the start is a formula to make all the books disappear! All the books in the world, including Gargamel's spells and Homnibus' books of remedies!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. They convince Gargamel to help them and the greedy villain runs to get the water, but manages to fall in with the troll. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf's worries make him break into a rash of worrywarts. The only way to relieve him of his bout of indecision-inducing disease is to have him rub the horn of a Wartmonger, a sloppy, slimy, stupid and brutal enemy of the Pussywillow Pixies...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poor Lazy! All he wants is a good night's rest. But no, all the Smurfs throw a party for him and, what's more, he gets dragged into a silly argument about painting giant Bigmouth's toes a bright tangerine red... It's a long, sleepless night for poor Lazy Smurf!

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel's sinister plan works too well. He just wanted a slight flood to drown the Smurfs. But this is almost the end of the world, and the Smurfs have to build an ark to survive... Will Smurfette's friend, the little winged horse, arrive on time?

programme.title: Babes In Wartland
programme.desc: Baby Smurf, playing hide-and-seek, hides in a basket that gets thrown in the river... Baby Smurf floats to the land of the Pussywillow Pixies... But the nasty, stupid Wartmonger reacts strangely to Baby...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The latest invention of both Greedy and Handy Smurf: a soft, refreshing delicacy that they call Smurf cream but that we humans know as ice cream. All would be well if rivalry did not come between the two Smurfs... And if Gargamel did not do his best to be unpleasant!

programme.title: The Bad Place
programme.desc: What is this little moon coming from above? Why, it's a crater-pockmarked globe of mud inhabited by the Grimeys, a family of mud-splattering, mud-eating creatures from out there in the sky. Not all the Smurfs are enthusiastic about the visitors....

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfomatic Smurfolator
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel still wants to destroy the Smurfs. This time, he sends on the forest the seeds of a creeping weed that is sure to entangle all the Smurfs… But Handy Smurf has devised a smurfomatic smurfolator...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Plotting to rid himself of the Smurfs, Gargamel casts a spell over Bigmouth and disguises himself as a Smurf. Thinking he is a Smurf, Bigmouth nearly succeeds in wrecking everything in the Village of the Smurfs until Papa Smurf comes up with a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Gargamel is able to make a flying carpet out of a patchwork quilt, accidents are bound to happen...The result of one accident is that a piece of the flying bedspread is used as Baby Smurf's diaper, with very surprising results...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: At last here is a post worthy of the great Gargamel's talent and experience! At least, that's what the evil wizard thinks as he learns of Prince Theodore's need of a new court magician. The Smurfs are delighted when they see Gargamel and his good-for-nothing apprentice, Scruple, leaving their hovel in the forest. But maybe they are rejoicing too soon. Who knows what peril Gargamel has in store?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Get up early in the morning, before any other Smurf is out of bed, to prepare a scrumptious Smurfberry muffin. Spend all morning on preparing Smurf delicacies for lunch. Than all afternoon to have dinner ready – and delicious – on time. And do you get so much as a thank you form the Smurfs? So Greedy Smurf quits. The Village is in trouble... And soon, so is Greedy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Yes, there can be too much of a good thing. When an accident happens to Papa Smurf's magic formula and he ends up multiplied by two, the Smurfs are elated: two Papa Smurfs can give twice the good counsel and twice the loving that one can. But after a while, things get too complex in the Village. Especially when another accident doubles the number of Gargamels!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Greenpeedeepee Swamp is the only place you can find Swamp Root, the delicious and necessary ingredient of Greedy Smurf’s famed swamp root stew. Unfortunately, it is also one place where you can find those hideous Wartmongers. Even though Sassette and the Smurfs save a young Wartmonger’s life, they still end up being captured by the others. But the Scarlet Croaker will save them! Maybe.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Horn Of Plenty
programme.desc: Mother Nature always does her best, but this time she's gone wrong. Her wand gets the wrong results and she accidentally damages the Autumn harvest. Now the Smurfs and all the forest animals face a lean and hungry winter. The only place where the Smurfs could get food would be the Land of Plenty. But Gargamel steals the famed Horn of Plenty to lure the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has hit on a revolutionary new idea: a sort of smurfless carriage that moves on railroad tracks. He calls it a railsmurfer and it makes for less work in the Village... until Gargamel chances upon it.

programme.title: Jokey's Joke Book
programme.desc: Jokey Smurf's joke boxes are no longer funny to the other Smurfs. Jokey finds new ideas in his Great Joke Book, but these ideas are even less popular in the Village. And here comes the evil Gargamel with a few jokes of his own...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: All The News That's Fit To Smurf
programme.desc: Curious Smurf has an idea: why not print a sheet with all the Village news? He's sure to interest all his readers of the Smurf Tattler. But things don't go exactly to plan when Papa finds super smurfberries.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Flighty Smurf, as his name implies, can't make his own mind up about anything. The other Smurfs take him to the forest for a survival test in which he can find his way home only by making decisions. He ends up in Balthazar's castle.

programme.title: Return To Don Smurfo
programme.desc: When a drop of Papa Smurf's new potion spills on the Smurflings' adventure book, the fictional hero springs to life. The dashing Don Smurfo, willing to rid the Smurf of the evil Gargamel, gallantly captures him...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: With Chitter his favourite squirrel mysteriously gone away, Wild Smurf feels very lonely. He haunts the Village despondently and his eyes light up only when Smurfette is about. The other Smurfs notice a sudden interest from Smurfette too...

programme.title: Vanity's Wild Adventure
programme.desc: Vanity Smurf is a finicky dresser; he takes care of his good looks and would do his utmost to avoid the tiniest grain of dust that might soil his attire. Wild Smurf is... Well, he's sort of wild. When both of them spend some time together, sparks fly...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel, the evil wizard, has come to the somewhat obvious conclusion that if he were a little faster on his feet, he'd be able to catch more Smurfs. He concocts a new formula while, in the Village, the Smurfs are wishing that Wild Smurf could slow down a little bit...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Winter is setting in on the Village of the Smurfs. The little Smurfs are freezing. But what is Clumsy doing with this strange rock he's discovered? And why is Miner Smurf so enthusiastic about their new discovery? Surely, one more addition to Clumsy's rock collection is not worth all this hoopla... The Smurfs will discover danger and surprises when they go underground.

programme.title: Scruple's Sweetheart
programme.desc: Brenda, the little witch, feels rejected: no-one is taking her to this year's Broomstick Ball. Oh, if she could find some nice-looking boy... Then she meets Scruple, apprentice of the evil wizard Gargamel. He's so handsome, and available too! What she does not know is that Scruple's only interest is her magic wand. What the Smurfs know is that they're going to save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's not his fault. Clumsy Smurf never stops causing catastrophes, and even when Papa Smurf sends him to the forest on a single errand, he brings back a cloud of bad luck the shadow of which causes misfortune to anyone – or any Smurf – under it... Papa Smurf is going to need all his resources to find a cure: the silver lining that every dark cloud ought to have!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy learns it’s better to have smurfed than not to have smurfed at all when he learns his true love is really a mermaid. Can they really live with each other forever?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy Smurf's misadventures take him across a river into Pussywillow Hollow. There he meets the Pixies – charming and shapely beings whose enemies, the Wartmongers, will meet the Smurfs in some unforeseen ways.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Desde los 12 años, una niña fue abusada por un pariente que luego se convirtió en su asesino. Jorge Alonso, tras evadir a la policía por 7 años y cambiar de identidad, fue capturado y espera juicio en Bucaramanga.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 14 de julio de 2013, la familia Mazo fue masacrada a machete en el barrio Villa Laura, Comuna 13, Medellín. Cuatro integrantes murieron, pero un niño de 11 años sobrevivió escondido bajo una cama, convirtiéndose en testigo clave. Aunque el motivo del ataque nunca se esclareció, las pruebas presentadas por la Fiscalía permitieron identificar a los responsables del crimen.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 28 de febrero de 2016, Helen Gordillo (9) fue asesinada en Villeta. Un mes después, Israel Rodríguez, vecino de la niña, fue capturado. El crimen habría sido por venganza, tras una discusión con la abuela de Helen por una deuda.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 05 de marzo del 2010, en la vereda Oro Perdido, del municipio de Cáqueza, una familia humilde y trabajadora terminan siendo víctima de un sangriento asesinato.

Capturado y condenado a 27 años por desaparición forzada, Nicolás rechazó un preacuerdo para revelar el paradero del cuerpo, prefiriendo cumplir toda su condena.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode we show you how we handle selling real estate in the midst of turkey season. We bounce around in this one going from taking the kids to school, handling business at the office, showing an amazing property, and finally getting some time to hunt. We hope this episode gives you a bit more insight on just how hectic and fast paced our Springs are at Hunting Land Man in Southwest Mississippi.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade gives you the grand tour of his home property. Slade’s dream was the same as many others, have a place where he can build a home, raise a family, and also have plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors and chase big rack bucks. Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and his former mate Captain Chris Walter take the Invincible cat to fish deep structure for a variety of snappers for Chris to cook for dinner.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared travels to Venice, Louisiana, where the Mississippi River meets the Gulf, joining Capt. Garrett George and Capt. Jesse Leboeuf for an action-packed offshore adventure in pursuit of Redfish and Tuna.

programme.title: Sail Kings

programme.title: Sail Kings

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The story of Team Winchester shooters Zach Kienbaum and Desirae Edmunds is told. Zach and Desi discuss how they got started in the shooting sports and how important coaching has become to both of them. They also talk shooting tips. Theo Ribbs breaks down the shotgun sports while Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Paul Sawyer, Nikki Boxler and Gabe Adair have a friendly sporting clays competition.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Northwest does not have the easiest conditions to train in for this shooting sports team. Also: Competition shooting tips form pro shooter Theo Ribbs.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB’s beautiful beach waters each summer. It’s a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt Justin says you can catch a redfish 365 days in Panama City Beach. We put those words to the test!

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Capt Brandon visits Quails Landing Plantation in South Georgia and his buddy Steven Redrick to do all things outdoors.

programme.title: Local Lines

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Building a new bison herd on the island of Sitkaladak, the indigenous Alutiiq community of Old Harbour take ownership of their food security and subsistence way of life.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the stories. With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Mya Go

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Benji & Joel Madden / Cameron Diaz & Katherine Power: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji and Joel Madden share their journey into artist management, while Cameron Diaz and Katherine Power discuss building their organic wine brand, Avaline.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jakob Nowell, frontman of Sublime and Jakob’s Castle, joins Joel Madden for an open conversation on legacy, sobriety, and finding identity beyond fame. Jakob reflects on growing up surrounded by music, his father’s influence, building his own sound, and the healing power of honesty in art.

programme.title: Gogol Bordello: Live From Union Transfer in Philadelphia
programme.desc: Gogol Bordello bring their post-punk energy to Philly’s Union Transfer. Their explosive global punky party is on full display.

programme.title: Say Anything: Is A Real Boy 20th Anniversary Tour Live from Los Angeles
programme.desc: Say Anything performs ...Is A Real Boy live at The Wiltern, celebrating the album’s 20th anniversary with a special concert event.

programme.title: Pitbull: Live at Rock In Rio
programme.desc: Pitbull performs at Rock in Rio, delivering global hits like Give Me Everything and International Love on a massive stage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Producer/guitarist Josh Carter—one half of genre-bending duo Phantogram—joins host Joel Madden to talk about why trying too hard can kill the art, his creative/lifelong bond with bandmate Sarah Barthel, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. From upstate New York origins to Brooklyn and now L.A., Josh digs into collaboration culture, beat-making roots, Big Grams with Big Boi, and the hip-hop influences (Beastie Boys, Wu-Tang, Public Enemy) that shaped his sound—plus a little baseball talk (Mets, Dodgers, Orioles).

programme.title: King 810: Memoirs Livestream From The Crofoot Ballroom
programme.desc: King 810 performs Memoirs of a Murderer live in full for the first time since 2014 in an intense concert filmed at the Crofoot Ballroom.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: DEVO: 50 Years of De-Evolution…Live!
programme.desc: DEVO performs at Denver’s Mission Ballroom, blending art, technology, and attitude in a high-energy live show.

programme.title: Incubus: The Morning View Sessions
programme.desc: The Morning View Sessions captures Incubus' fourth album release day. Features live hits Nice to Know You, Wish You Were Here, Warning, and Circles.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Foxing: Live at The Grandel
programme.desc: Foxing performs 'Draw Down The Moon' for 'Live At The Grandel' Album. Filmed at The Grandel in St. Louis, MO.

programme.title: Judas Priest: Epitaph
programme.desc: Judas Priest performs a powerful final tour set at Hammersmith Apollo, featuring songs spanning their 40-year career.

programme.title: Boys Like Girls: The Soundtrack of your life tour
programme.desc: Boys Like Girls celebrate 20 years and 17 years of 'Love Drunk' with a special anniversary performance on The Soundtrack of Your Life Tour streaming live from Anaheim.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Third Eye Blind frontman Stephan Jenkins joins Joel Madden to discuss songwriting, creativity, and the band’s upcoming album. Jenkins opens up about perfectionism, the struggle to finish lyrics, and the human element that drives his music. He also shares insights on producing, the influence of Eric Valentine, and gearing up for The Summer Gods Tour with Yellowcard and A R I Z O N A.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sam Carter, the powerhouse vocalist of Architects, for a candid conversation about gut instincts, creative integrity, and nearly two decades of building one of heavy music’s most influential bands. Sam opens up about his serendipitous bond with Good Charlotte, the “say yes or say no” mindset that guides his decisions, and how gratitude—and a little British self-deprecation—keep him grounded. He reflects on Warped Tour dreams turned stadium reality, the band’s tight-knit dynamic, and why this era is about smiling more, having fun, and bringing the wide-eyed 13-year-old version of himself back on stage. They also talk about Architects’ new album, The Sky, The Earth & All Between (out Feb 28), aiming to make their 11th record their biggest and most honest yet.

programme.title: I Go To The Rock: The Gospel of Whitney Houston
programme.desc: Whitney Houston's voice is powerful and timeless. Her heart was always in Gospel music. From her first performance to the best-selling Gospel album, The Preacher's Wife.

programme.title: Good Charlotte: Fast Future Generation
programme.desc: Fast Future Generation features Good Charlotte's 2005 Japan tour with interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and live performances.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: The Wedding Planners 2
programme.desc: For some brides, it’s not about budget—it’s all about the bling.Bling on the Bride is a one-hour documentary where today’s shiniest trends take center stage. Wedding consultant Tara Mandy and event planner Steve Kemble will discuss the latest trends and most innovative ways to add bling to any wedding. Jewelry is where it starts, from the traditional engagement rings of Tiffany & Co to the high-priced engagement rings worn by the hottest celebrities and the finest wedding jewelry creations of “designer to the stars” Neil Lane.You’ll meet wedding cake designer Ron Ben-Israel, known for the edible bling that adorns his creations. And Mark Ingram will show you how the hottest wedding gown designers are using bling to make their hostesses shine. And you’ll meet Brooke Webster and see the lengths she’ll go to make her wedding day sparkle and why for her there’s just never enough bling.

programme.title: Day of the Dead Bride
programme.desc: David can’t helped but be creeped-out when this bride-to-be has wedding day visions that bring the Dawn of the Dead to mind? With Halloween far away on the calendar, David has his work cut out for him to make sure this wedding looks less like a vampire movie video and more like one of his elegant events. With a bride who has a lust for blood, can David create a wedding to remember without inspiring guests to run screaming from the celebration?

programme.title: Greek Goddess Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera's next bride thinks her fiancé is a "Greek god," and what else would that mean, but a Greek themed wedding?! Instead of an elegant affair, the bride wants statues, golden centerpieces and a bridal party outfitted in white robes. David quickly decides to tread lightly with this bride. For him there's a fine line between the Dionysian elegance of the brides’ dreams and what could end up looking like a fraternity toga party!

programme.title: Bling Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera knows that every bride wants to be a bright, shining star at her wedding, but when it comes to his new bride Joanne Oleary, he’s going to have to come up with a new definition for “Bling!”. When Joanne explains that she’s hoping for the ultimate bling wedding: glamour and sparkly fashion at every turn, with her as the diamond in the center, she challenges David to outdo her vision. But as David sees what Joanne has put together, he finds a mismatched mess: shoes on guest tables, sequined fabric for the walls, and flashlights stuck to the walls as makeshift lanterns. Over three weeks, David transforms Joanne’s wedding into a nuclear explosion of blinged-out fabulousness! New dresses and jewelry for Joanne’s bridesmaids, a sexy and elegant new gown for Joanne, and for a surprise that is sure to knock her socks off, Joanne and her girls get to star in their own professional fashion shoot!

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has a special gift that turns any bride’s concept into an unforgettable, dramatic event. And when he meets bride Amber Fleener, who wants the ultimate “Phantom of the Opera” wedding, David knows he’s the right man for the job. But instead of romance and drama, David finds that while Amber is hoping for a grand production of Phantom, what’s she come up with is more like a high school play. With cheap costume masks and fake flowers that look like Christmas decorations, and a venue that’s more suited for a block party, Amber is in dire need of David’s help. Before she knows it, David is revising everything, giving her a stunning and dramatic new bridal gown, putting her bridesmaids in romantic, classic dresses, and changing the venue to one suitable for the huge production she’s hoping for. David even gives Amber an unforgettable rehearsal dinner with family and friends before the big night!

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland Bride
programme.desc: Bride Chrissy Pumphrey-Duran and fiancé Jason Smith share a love for literature, so when it came time to decide on a theme for their wedding, they thought that Lewis Carroll’s classic tale “Alice in Wonderland” would be perfect. But when David Tutera meets with the bride to see what she’s come up with, he finds that Chrissy has gone way too far! From the black and white striped socks, she plans to wear under her black bridal gown to the chin-strapped top hats she’s putting on her bridesmaids, this wedding needs a major rewrite! With only three weeks before the wedding, David rushes into action, changing Chrissy’s dreary, gothic bridal gown to an elegant and dramatic gown worthy of her classic theme, gives the bridesmaids much needed color in their dresses, and moving the venue from a local club to a Hollywood soundstage. David even gives his bride a once-in-a-lifetime experience: a magical tea party with her as the guest of honor!

programme.title: Monet & Shane
programme.desc: After a nine-year separation, Monet and Shane picked up where they'd left off and have now planned a fairy tale wedding with a 20 member bridal party and an Italian gown with a price tag of over $10,000!!

programme.title: Wizard of Oz Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has created countless classic wedding themes in his career as a wedding planner, but his latest bride Aime Simmons and her “Wizard of Oz” themed wedding has David ready to click his heels together and wish for home. From the poinsettia centerpieces to the giant lollipops to the construction paper yellow brick road Aime wants to walk down, David has his work cut out for him. He upgrades Aime’s wedding dress to a gorgeous bridal gown, complete with genuine ruby slippers and takes her bridesmaids out of their munchin-themed outfits, putting them into stunning, elegant dresses fit for a trip to the emerald city. With so many great changes and not enough room in Aime’s venue, David moves the wedding’s location to a picturesque California mountain ranch. Just when Aime thinks David is done surprising her, he reveals his final one: an afternoon trip that will really test the bride’s courage!

programme.title: Safari Bride
programme.desc: Even with his history of creating the most amazing and beautiful weddings, David Tutera sometimes runs into brides who can’t trust him and let go of the work they’ve already put into their weddings. Such is the case with David’s newest bridge, Shelby Ellis of Orange, California. With her own design background and dreams of going into event and wedding planning herself, Shelby was hoping that her wedding day would be perfect. But Shelby has gone wild with her “Passport to Africa” theme by choosing the wrong dress, booking a ceremony space that doesn’t fit the theme, and covered everything in zebra stripes. She’s put it on her table accessories, on the groom’s tie, and even the bridesmaid’s dresses! David has got plenty to do, but finds that Shelby is resistant every change he makes. Can David convince his bride to trust him and still have the time to put on a majestic and elegant wedding in only 3 weeks?

programme.title: Breast Cancer Survivor Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera’s always gets to know his brides when trying to give them the wedding day of their dreams. When he meets bride Kimberly Read, a breast cancer survivor, David is touched by her story, and dedicates himself to making sure Kimberly’s inspirational story comes through in her wedding. Kimberly’s theme, 1950’s Havana, present David with plenty of challenges on its own, but Kimberly’s hope to include breast cancer awareness into the theme gives David an even bigger set of hurdles. David replaces Kimberly’s standard dress with an incredible and fantastic gown that has the Cuban flair she’s looking for, and takes her bridesmaids out of their plan dresses and puts them into sultry, sexy, and classy gowns straight out of Havana. David’s not done with the surprises, though. He enlists a little bit of help from the people who know and love Kimberly the most for an unforgettable and emotional wedding day surprise.

programme.title: Mini-truck Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera always makes sure his weddings tell the story of the bride and groom, incorporating not just their lives together, but any common interests they may have. His new bride Michelle may have taken things too far when trying to work in the hobby she shares with fiancé Josh: mini-trucks. After Michelle shows David what she’s put together: mini license plates and toy cars for the reception tables, bridesmaids in dresses out of their own closets, and a wedding dress even she doesn’t like, David faces a tough challenge. David gives her the exquisite bridal gown of her dreams, puts her bridesmaids in elegant matching dresses, and even uses her love of trucks into a rehearsal for an important wedding day moment. On Michelle’s wedding day, David uses her mini-truck theme to create and amazing, elegant, yet fun reception hall she’ll never forget!

programme.title: Winter Wonderland Bride
programme.desc: When it comes to making dream weddings come true, there’s no one better than David Tutera. But when he meets his newest bride, Amber, her vision looks more like a nightmare than a dream! She has her heart set on getting married in a snowy winter wonderland, despite the fact that she lives in Southern California. And that’s not all: she also wants to work in tributes to both her Indonesian heritage as well as her husband’s last name: Ace. When Amber shows David what she has planned: Christmas flowers and decorations as centerpieces, wooden Indonesian statues, and playing cards everywhere, he’s more confused than ever. Amber’s planned fashion is no better: mismatched bridesmaid dresses and a gown she borrowed from an aunt. David spends the next three weeks turning Amber’s avalanche of corny into a magical Winter Wonderland straight out of a fantasy.

Kimberly Marrero has style and grace and a beautiful wedding gown. Her bridesmaids dresses don’t fit David’s vision of an elegant big day, so they are the first to change. And why the change? David wants to give Kimberly a Great Gatsby inspired wedding and where better to celebrate but Oheka Castle? And while our bride looks divine in her wedding dress, David surprises her with a reception dress perfect to dance away the night! Vintage accessories will be the finishing touches that make this bride look like she stepped out of a story book from the 1920’s.

programme.title: Springtime and Flowers Bride
programme.desc: Every bride has her wedding lists, but David Tutera is about to meet a controlling bride who has lists for her lists and more lists. Jaymie Wildin wants a springtime wedding, but her log cabin venue makes it feel more like a ski trip getaway! And will she let David change the wedding gown she’s determined to keep? A “fashion crime” is how David describes the bridesmaids dresses, so they have to go. Jamie’s two main wishes for her wedding are fresh flowers and a fabulous cake, so making his brides dreams come true, David has Jamie pick out her favorite perennials, followed by a trip to a cake designer that brings a huge smile to her face! And the surprises don’t stop there! David lets her know that she will be getting married in a beautiful venue full of whimsical wonderment fit for a springtime bride.

programme.title: Poker Bride
programme.desc: Lucky in love is a great saying for a wedding, but when you add poker chips, LED dice on a garter, and red and black feathers, you’ll be lucky if you know where you are! David Tutera meets Nicole Goodman and finds out that her wedding is all over the place. Her wedding gown makes her look like a lounge singer and his first change is to have her try three styles of his bridal gown designs. Then the bridesmaids have to be dressed to the nines to shine at the wedding. Then David has a first for the show with the groom to be getting a custom tailored tuxedo. And while the bride and groom are together with David, they learn that their venue is being changed to the Prince George Ballroom. The surprises continue as Nicole’s wedding day has a special guest flown in and the happy couple get a honeymoon fit for two people “lucky in love”!

programme.title: Zen Bride
programme.desc: Planning a wedding usually involves some chaos, even for David Tutera. But he’s about to meet a bride whose zen themed wedding has her so calm, David’s not sure why he’s there. First of all, her décor is beautiful, bridesmaid’s dresses are lovely and her wedding gown is absolutely perfect for her ceremony. So why is he there? David meets the brides Mother who is a big part of Jessica’s wedding. And even Mom, a big part of the wedding, is good to go. Jessica and David go to her reception venue, and it’s better suited for a rehearsal dinner than a wedding, and there’s NO dance floor! Where will the bride and groom have their first dance? The wedding itself is Chic Island Elegance, with green and white d�cor and amber lighting. Orchid chandeliers, glittering carved ice elements, and a Miami club themed after party captivate their guests.

programme.title: CHRISTINE & JONATHAN
programme.desc: All brides should be as fortunate as Christine. When she can't find the perfect chapel for her wedding to Jonathan, her father builds her one! And he doesn't stop there. He creates an entire $4 million wedding village, including a high-tech reception ballroom, a perfect courtyard for cocktail hour, luxe suites for the bridal party, and even a jewelry store and a spa for pre-wedding pampering. For Christine's special day, she and her designer fill the ballroom and chapel with a romantic secret garden look, highlighted by manzanita wood centerpieces dripping with hydrangeas and orchids. The evening is rounded out with gourmet dinner stations and a whimsical “Mad hatter” style wedding cake.

Throughout the ceremony and reception are dozens of dramatic, large, pav� yellow rose balls, evoking the image of baseballs. The groom's cake fits the theme to a T, looking so much like an actual baseball glove that it's almost a shame to eat it.

programme.desc: The guests of a Black Eyed Peas guitarist and a Hollywood hairstylist are in for an adventure of a lifetime when the couple whisks them away to Mexico. They have several events planned at the lush Xcaret eco park, from a rocking welcome party to swimming with sharks, to the wedding itself. The ceremony has a very Spanish feel in its ancient open-air chapel, complete with bridesmaids in purple charmeuse gowns and red roses in their hair flanking the gorgeous bride with a custom peineta holding her veil in place. It's followed by an incredible reception in a cave that's vibrantly decked out in reds and purples.

programme.title: NATALIE & BOB
programme.desc: A library has never looked as breathtaking as Sacramento's Tsakopoulos Library looks decked out in Natalie and Bob's wedding d�cor. The soaring space is draped in 48-yard-long panels of red fabric, and underneath are exquisite tablescapes of silver-edged place settings and centerpieces created from 20 types of red flowers. This fun-loving couple makes the most of their preparations, with a gourmet food tasting to narrow down their menu, and a decadent wine and chocolate tasting party with their friends. The bride makes a foray into an exclusive jewelry store that results in $1 million of wedding day glam.

programme.title: CRISTINA & JORGE
programme.desc: Two elements characterize the wedding of Cristina and Jorge: their Cuban heritage and perfectly executed pops of color. It's important to the couple that the food is incredible, and since they're in South Beach, Florida, their chef incorporates Cuban spices and fruits into a steak and lobster dinner to create a modern “Floribbean” feast. The d�cor has an elegant, clean look with a lot of black and white, while drama comes from fuchsia accents. Crystal-filled vases are topped with a stunning cube-shaped design of 600 bright pink double dianthus flowers per centerpiece. And the wedding cake is one-of-a-kind: layers of cake draped in black fondant fronted with fuchsia and white rectangles alternate with layers of acrylic boxes filled with crystals!

programme.title: Swamp Bride
programme.desc: What is David Tutera to do with a bride who is allergic to flowers and wants her wedding décor to resemble a swamp? This is a first for David, and with only three weeks until the wedding, he’s going to either sink or swim. His first challenge is to get his head strong bride to agree to change out her wedding gown. Not easy. And as for the bridesmaid’s dresses that look like lily pads? Oh yes, they are second to go! Since David’s bride has such a unique vision for her big day, he’s on a quest for one-of-a-kind wedding favors. Favors that have to include frogs – yes, frogs. And finally, it’s time to face the challenge of what food to serve at this wedding, so what better than a yummy food tasting. And when the big day finally arrives, our bride has all of Manhattan as a backdrop and fireworks to finalize a magical day.

programme.title: Diva Bride
programme.desc: They say everything is bigger in Texas, and so is the personality of David Tutera’s new Dallas bride. When she says “diva”, you better say ‘licious” , because she’s a force to be reckoned with. How do you combine Lady Gaga, Beyonce, Mardi Gras and pink feathers into a wedding? With three weeks until the big day, David decides to make everything off the charts! Glittery, glamorous reception dresses for not only the bride but the bridesmaids as well. And nothing says “diva” like an over-the-top photo shoot! And what better location for this production, than a theater complete with a red carpet entrance!

programme.title: Cowgirl Bride
programme.desc: With many brides, the dress is the most important thing for her wedding. But with David Tutera’s next bride – it’s all about the cowboy boots! This Texas cowgirl is dead set on two stepping her way into the sunset, and David is determined to have her step into a pair of nice heels! The challenges start with giving the bride a sophisticated gown to wear – with or without boots! And speaking of boots, how about bridal boot camp to get into shape for the big day? A picture-perfect Texas ranch transforms into the ideal setting for our country bride to dance the night away under the stars.

programme.title: Pirate Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has planned plenty of destination weddings, so when he heard about a Caribbean wedding, the last thing he thought it would be was, “pirates of the Caribbean”! David’s latest bride, Brooke Lewis loves the idea of pirates, but instead of planning an elegant wedding, it’s turning into a 5-year-olds birthday party! So her décor and venue are the first to go when David takes over the planning. Brooke gets a beautiful and romantic wedding gown, and the bridesmaids are decked out in jewel-toned dresses. And since this bride is a true treasure, she needs to wear stunning jewels – how about $250,000 worth? And just when she thinks the surprises are done, David takes her on a little climbing expedition. Something that will make her trust her wedding planner as well as letting off a little steam.

programme.title: Butterfly Bride
programme.desc: Where does David Tutera begin with a bride who wants butterflies, rainbows, butterflies and then more butterflies? Monique Villegas is a sweet bride who loves colors and whimsy but has no idea how to pull off a wedding. With only 3 weeks before her big day, David takes charge, and the magic begins. Rainbows are captured in the Swarovski crystal jewelry that our bride tries on. And how about a champagne toast at sunset in a private jet, flying high above Los Angeles to make a brides dreams come true?
