programme.desc: It’s Tuesday…And you can ask him ANYTHING! But don’t complain when Dr. Phil gives you the truth as he sees it. One 24-year-old turns to Dr. Phil because of something she just can’t let go of… her “Blankie.” She’s had it forever but now it’s affecting her marriage. Plus, tune-in to find out why Hollywood’s hottest celebrities are turning to Dr. Phil for “Get Real” solutions; and find out what Phil’s wife Robin thinks of him when he’s off stage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They lied, cheated, and fought like cats and dogs! Now, Dr. Phil brings back some of his most memorable guests. One cheating husband admits he had another affair just one week after the show. Will an emotional encounter with his daughters be the wakeup call he needs? And whatever happened to the dueling twin sisters that vowed to stop fighting—did they keep their promise? Plus, find out how one feuding couple salvaged their relationship after the show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when spouses won’t pull their own weight as a parent? One wife complains that her husband always leaves their newborn with a sitter so he can have free time. What’s the reason behind his hands-off approach? Then, meet one new mom who’s ready to leave her husband because he refuses to help with their baby. Will this apathetic father change his ways? Also, Dr. Phil helps a stay-at-home mom control her destructive outbursts.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you think sexual predators are perverts who lurk in the bushes, on the Internet, or hang out at school yards, you couldn't be more wrong. What if they were a member of your family? What if you found out that your own child was molesting other children?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Could your child be the target of a bully? Young bullies and savage school bus beatings are on the rise. One mother moved so her son could be in a safer school; shortly thereafter, he was brutally attacked by seven boys on the school bus. Then, you won’t believe the shocking school bus footage of one young girl who kicked, stepped on, and beat another girl unconscious! You’ll be surprised why the bully thinks her behavior was justified. Plus, learn how you can protect your child from becoming the next victim.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're a college student or the parent of one, you don't want to miss today's show. Robin McGraw shares her secrets for adjusting to an empty nest, and Dr. Phil has advice for making the most out of the college experience.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother's suspicion, a dirty secret from the past and shocking allegations continue as Sherie-Lynn and her husband, Todd, confront the man they suspect has molested Sherie-Lynn's son, Parker. Did her father, Al, violate his own grandson? Catch up on what you missed in A Boy in Trouble.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If two people are truly in love, does anyone have the right to judge them? What if their relationship crosses moral boundaries? Dr. Phil's guests have been accused of causing turmoil and chaos in their families because of their unconventional relationships.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four moms who are tired of leading a double life confessed why they live in fear, shame and guilt. See what happened. Now, three more women who have spent years hiding their secret reveal the truth to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tired of leading a double life, these seven women confessed to Dr. Phil why they live in fear, shame and guilt. See what's happened. Now they go face-to-face with the men they've been deceiving.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A new desperate housewife is ready to spill her secret to Dr. Phil. Plus, he checks in with the other women and the secrets they could no longer hide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles the emotionally-charged topic of DNA tests. Recently making news, Spice Girl Mel B. had a DNA test done to prove Eddie Murphy was the father of their baby. Dr. Phil conducts a paternity test for one of his guests and gives you the chance to be there when he reads the results " but don't expect any brawling theatrics on Dr. Phil's stage!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These seven women say they live in fear every single day that their painful secrets will be discovered - secrets that could land them in jail, destroy their marriages, and even cost them their lives. They go face-to-face with Dr. Phil in a two-day workshop to finally stop living their masquerades and start revealing the truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s not just the title of a 90’s sitcom. Today Dr. Phil looks at kids leaving home – a healthy and sometimes welcome event in many parents’ lives, but one that can leave some with feelings of loss and emptiness. Hear how one mom cries herself to sleep each night in her daughter’s bed and calls her at least five times a day. You’ll also meet a widowed mother of eight who’s still paralyzed by grief since her youngest daughter left home four years ago. Join Dr. Phil as he helps these women learn to make themselves a priority and create a new role as mothers of adult children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: We all know someone who's been in a bad breakup, but Dr. Phil's guests say they've got ex-mates from hell!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: She’s suing McDonalds because her child got fat from their fast food. No, really! We’re serious! Is this unprecedented court battle just mom’s way of blaming someone else, or does she have a legitimate beef? Join Dr. Phil as he tackles this highly publicized case and takes on mom and her attorney. And in another “weighty” issue... can airlines make this passenger purchase 2 tickets because he can’t fit in a single chair? Plus, we’ll have one man who’s suing an airline for seating him next to an overwieght passenger. He claims he paid for a full seat and didn’t get to use all of it! Join us for “battles of the bulge.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil checks in with some of his most memorable guests to see if they took his advice or went back to their old ways.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marriage is a wonderful thing, but for some of today’s couples, times are tough and they are turning to Dr. Phil for help. His first couple faces a future apart if they can’t find a fix for their marital woes. She suspects him of cheating, and in retaliation she’s mismanaged their money and forged his name on credit cards. Dr. Phil challenges them to restore their relationship - if not for each other then for their children. You’ll also witness the startling revelation behind another husband’s angry outbursts as he confronts a demon he’s denied for years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever thought: pretty people get all the breaks? Well, even some of the most beautiful people have a rough time in the love department. Rebecca dated Dyson for eight years and knew he was a cheater, but thought marrying him would change his ways. Dyson says he married Rebecca because she "earned it," but says he doesn't like that the ring on his finger hinders women from coming up to him. Rebecca suspects that Dyson has cheated on her since they've been married. Is she right? See what makes Dyson storm offstage. Then, Tiffany says when her husband, George, lost 50 pounds, he started gagging at the sight of her body. So, she got $20,000 worth of plastic surgery, hoping he would only have eyes for her. But it wasn't enough to keep George faithful. Tiffany says she's more gorgeous than any of the women he had affairs with, so why isn't her husband looking her way?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Since the dawn of time, since the first man and woman gave birth to the first bouncing bundle of joy, parents everywhere have asked the same question throughout the ages… How do I get my kid to do what I need them to do? From potty training to picking up their rooms to not picking on their little siblings – Parents have got a million questions and Dr. Phil is here to help. Tune in to learn the secrets to child rearing that will improve your life and your children’s behavior!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ricky and Ray say their brother, Robin, has been stealing their identities for years. Robin has used his older brother’s ID to open lines of credit, rent a mobile home and even tried to buy a Harley using their good names and credit. Worst of all, they say Robin has used his brothers’ names when he has been arrested, causing warrants to be issued in their names. They feel the problem is so bad that Ricky’s fiancée, Robyn, is worried about taking his last name after the wedding because of the similarity to his brother’s name. They want to confront their brother, but haven't been able to find him. With Dr. Phil's help on stage, the confrontation finally takes place. Plus, identity theft can happen anywhere. Identity thieves get personal information by stealing records from the office, or rummaging through the trash. Dr. Phil wanted to see just how easily identity theft occurs, so staff members did a little snooping around the Dr. Phil offices at night to see what people had on their desks or in their trash. You won’t believe the results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When couples tie the knot, they don't just marry each other; they get hitched to their spouse's entire family. But what would you do if your in-laws were demanding, condescending and sometimes violent?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Julie likes to baby talk to get her way, and her frustrated husband says, "This is not normal." Jesse likes to make fun of the people around her. She wonders, "Is it sick and twisted?" Rachel's parents constantly embarrass her by French kissing in public. Angie weighs 235 pounds and knows she's overweight, but sees a thin person in the mirror. Mollie is a 32-year-old who still sucks her thumb. She wants Dr. Phil's advice on how to stop.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone experiences it at some point in their lives, but some people are jealous of everyone they meet. Dr. Phil’s first guest is so consumed by jealousy that she even compares herself to strangers in the checkout line. Can Dr. Phil help her get beyond this self-destructive attitude? Then, a woman who is so jealous of her husband’s past that she makes him pay for it daily. Dr. Phil conducts a relationship rescue and gets to the source of her green-eyed monster!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you judge people before you even meet them? Dr. Phil puts his studio audience to the test to see how judgmental people really are! Meet Jaron, who says women like him... until they find out he used to be a woman! Then, as an actress and former news anchor, Bree Walker says she's endured extreme cruelty because of a physical deformity to her hands. Now, she endures constant criticism and guilt for passing this genetic disorder onto her child. Plus, a preacher’s wife who says she's sick of being critical of everyone. Can Dr. Phil help her change her judgmental ways?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: "I got stuck in traffic." "The check is in the mail." "No, you don't look fat in those jeans." Everyone fibs once in a while, right? Dr. Phil talks to people accused of being compulsive liars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is money really the root of all evil? Today's guests would say so. They have spent themselves so far into debt that they have no idea how to pull themselves out. The stress is destroying their marriages and relationships with concerned loved ones.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Angie says her sister, Gwen, is the most annoying person on the planet! She rants, raves and flips the bird to total strangers. She even teaches Angie’s 2-year-old curse words. Gwen says her behavior is funny and thinks Angie needs to lighten up. Watch what happens when Dr. Phil plans an experiment and gives Gwen a taste of her own medicine! Then, remember the lovable loudmouth, Becky? Her daughter, Sara, said she swore like a drunken sailor, and could be heard from miles away. Becky said she was simply opinionated, honest and blunt. Has she been able to keep her big mouth shut since she was on the show? Plus, Taylor and Cassidy say their mom, Suzanne’s, obsession with watching Dr. Phil is driving them nuts!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Fast food, video games and a sedentary lifestyle are combining to make one out of every three kids in the United States overweight. With the population of obese children ballooning to epidemic proportions, Dr. Phil reaches out to parents everywhere in today’s show. He goes one-on-one with the mother of a 4- year-old, 150lb. child to discuss her son’s life-threatening condition. Hear why she thinks countless doctors and nutritionists haven’t been able to help her little boy, and learn what role Dr. Phil thinks she has to play in her son’s well being.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you’re a parent, get ready to take notes! Dr. Phil tackles the most frequently asked questions. Find out how to cope with the terrible two’s and even how to calm a crying baby in seconds! Plus, Dr. Phil talks to one couple who doesn’t know what to do with their toddler’s biting habit. Another mother is distraught about her oversensitive crybaby. Are their parenting methods to blame? And if you think one baby is a handful, wait until you hear from parents of 3-month-old quintuplets!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you had it with a rude and crude relative or friend? Or do people incorrectly label you as one? Dr. Phil offers advice for putting an end to offensive behavior.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How many times have you heard your spouse say, "I'm right, and you're wrong"? Dr. Phil's guests are in a stand-off, and they want him to settle their dispute once and for all! Carla says her dog, Thomas, is her number one priority, but her husband, Tony, says she's gone way overboard with her puppy love. Tony says that Thomas gets the run of the house, and Carla cuddles with Thomas in bed instead of him. Should Carla make room for Tony, or does Tony need to get over his canine envy? Next up is a family caught in a style war. Betty lets her 15- and 11-year-old daughters wear short shorts, high heels and thong underwear. Her husband, Richie, says he'd rather see them covered from head to toe. Does Richie need to get with the times and realize these girls are just dressing in style, or has Betty let the girls take it too far? Then, Christine says her husband, Kevin, is out five nights a week playing or coaching sports, leaving her home with their 1-year-old son. Kevin says he deserves to get away from the ruckus of a chaotic household, and Christine knew he was a jock when they got married. Can Kevin learn to say no to others and yes to his wife and child? And, Lisa says her husband, Erik's, passion for flying is too dangerous, and he needs to give it up now that they have three young sons. Erik says flying is in his blood and it’s safer than driving a car. When Dr. Phil shares a personal story, will it put Lisa at ease?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests are torn apart by jealousy, lies and deceit. They say they’re at a crossroads in their relationship and are trying to decide whether to stay or cut their losses and walk out. Terry says her partner, Chris – whom she used to be married to -- is insanely jealous and constantly accuses her of cheating on him with another of her ex-husbands, Jim. Chris goes as far as marking the tires on Terry’s vehicle to see if she’s left the house to be with another man. Terry and Jim say they are business partners only and are tired of Chris spying on them outside their business. Terry says Chris’s jealous suspicions are the reason their marriage crumbled after only three months, and she’s not going through that again. So why is she still with him? Then, Amy recently discovered her husband of 16 years, Donovan, cheated on her with five other women. Now she’s torn and wondering if she can -- or should -- ever trust him again.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You've heard the old saying, "Blood is thicker than water." Dr. Phil's guests are putting that adage to the test!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every parent thinks their children are special, but some mothers will pay any price to get their kids in the spotlight. Two moms discuss the consequences of chasing fame for their child.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Love can be blind... but what if you found out you were married to your own sibling? That's what happened to Jonnie and Dennis who dreamed about spending their lives together until they learned the disturbing truth. Is it legally and morally acceptable for them to stay married? Then, a daughter who's furious and feels betrayed because her 69-year-old father left her mother for a 27-year-old woman. And, should another guest get back together with her ex who served 23 years in prison for armed robbery and kidnapping? Find out what Dr. Phil thinks.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Women beware: Men are on the prowl! Some guys win your heart and dupe you for thousands of dollars, while other men learn the slick techniques of pick-up artists so they can get you in the sack! Go inside a classroom where single men are being taught The Mystery Method -- a step-by-step technique on how to meet, attract and date beautiful women. The founders say their method teaches guys to be more confident. When the students hit the bars, will The Mystery Method help them land a lady? What do the women think of their techniques? Then, meet Ross Jeffries, the self-proclaimed "Father of Seduction." He says he’s taught thousands of men to seduce women through language. Now he fears that he’s created monsters, because many of his followers are seducing woman through deception, and he says that’s exactly what The Mystery Method is all about. A heated debate ensues between Ross and the creators of The Mystery Method, Nick and Scott. Is Ross’ technique actually as benign as he claims? And, Victoria says she fell in love for the first time with a guy whom who she thought was the perfect man, until she says he scammed her out of $100,000. Did Victoria miss the warning signs? How can she pick up the pieces of her broken heart and move on? If you’re a lady looking for love but don't want to find heartache, you won’t want to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These guests say they can’t stop living the “Hollywoodlife".

programme.title: Top 5 Cold Cases: The Lie Detector
programme.desc: Jodie’s 15-year-old sister, Reesa, was brutally murdered on June 14, 1984. Jodie says she was only 13 years old and considered a prime suspect but the case went cold. It’s been over three decades, and she says the townspeople haven’t stopped gossiping and accusing her of murdering her only sibling. Will Jodie take Dr. Phil’s polygraph and end all the rumors? Then, Rachel accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt agrees to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal? Next, When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents say they believe their daughter was murdered. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Then, Dr. Phil delves into the mystery of 15-year-old Erica Parsons, who was last seen nearly two years ago but was only recently reported missing. Casey and Sandy -- the adoptive parents -- are offered a chance to take a polygraph test. Finally, 17-year-old Josh Young says his father, Joshua Gouker, tried to frame him in the 2011 murder of his stepbrother, Trey Zwicker -- only to later confess to the murder himself. Gouker’s cousin, Cassi, says she was asked to dispose of a weapon and bloody clothes. Can Dr. Phil get to the truth?

programme.title: Top 5 Polygraph Reveals
programme.desc: Heather says her 19-year-old daughter, Nicki, has a history of lying and has faked two pregnancies and even fabricated a childbirth. Nicki admits that she lied about the first pregnancy but insists she really was pregnant the second time -- but had an abortion and was too scared to tell her mom. Nicki agrees to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal? Next, Barbie says her boyfriend, Travis, constantly accuses her of cheating and stealing money – which she denies. What proof does Travis say he has to support his claims? Barbie agrees to take a polygraph test to prove her innocence once and for all. Then, It’s been three years since Glenn Lemoine’s body was found floating in a canal, and his death remains a mystery. His family wants answers -- and they’re pointing the finger at each other. Two agree to take polygraph tests -- what will the results reveal? Next, Sarah says the last thing she remembers is taking her two young boys, ages 2 and 4, to the gas station, until she turned up at an area hospital miles away -- 13 hours later. Did she really lose her memory, or is she making the whole story up? Sarah undergoes a polygraph examination regarding her memory of what occurred during those 13 hours. Finally, Kelly says on August 2, 2011, he found his wife, Margaret, dead in the bathtub. Police ruled her death an accidental drowning -- but Margaret’s friends, Nancy and Christine, say they think she was murdered by her husband. Don’t miss his polygraph results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s Tuesday…And you can ask him ANYTHING! But don’t complain when Dr. Phil gives you the truth as he sees it. One 24-year-old turns to Dr. Phil because of something she just can’t let go of… her “Blankie.” She’s had it forever but now it’s affecting her marriage. Plus, tune-in to find out why Hollywood’s hottest celebrities are turning to Dr. Phil for “Get Real” solutions; and find out what Phil’s wife Robin thinks of him when he’s off stage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They lied, cheated, and fought like cats and dogs! Now, Dr. Phil brings back some of his most memorable guests. One cheating husband admits he had another affair just one week after the show. Will an emotional encounter with his daughters be the wakeup call he needs? And whatever happened to the dueling twin sisters that vowed to stop fighting—did they keep their promise? Plus, find out how one feuding couple salvaged their relationship after the show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when spouses won’t pull their own weight as a parent? One wife complains that her husband always leaves their newborn with a sitter so he can have free time. What’s the reason behind his hands-off approach? Then, meet one new mom who’s ready to leave her husband because he refuses to help with their baby. Will this apathetic father change his ways? Also, Dr. Phil helps a stay-at-home mom control her destructive outbursts.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you think sexual predators are perverts who lurk in the bushes, on the Internet, or hang out at school yards, you couldn't be more wrong. What if they were a member of your family? What if you found out that your own child was molesting other children?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Could your child be the target of a bully? Young bullies and savage school bus beatings are on the rise. One mother moved so her son could be in a safer school; shortly thereafter, he was brutally attacked by seven boys on the school bus. Then, you won’t believe the shocking school bus footage of one young girl who kicked, stepped on, and beat another girl unconscious! You’ll be surprised why the bully thinks her behavior was justified. Plus, learn how you can protect your child from becoming the next victim.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're a college student or the parent of one, you don't want to miss today's show. Robin McGraw shares her secrets for adjusting to an empty nest, and Dr. Phil has advice for making the most out of the college experience.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother's suspicion, a dirty secret from the past and shocking allegations continue as Sherie-Lynn and her husband, Todd, confront the man they suspect has molested Sherie-Lynn's son, Parker. Did her father, Al, violate his own grandson? Catch up on what you missed in A Boy in Trouble.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If two people are truly in love, does anyone have the right to judge them? What if their relationship crosses moral boundaries? Dr. Phil's guests have been accused of causing turmoil and chaos in their families because of their unconventional relationships.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four moms who are tired of leading a double life confessed why they live in fear, shame and guilt. See what happened. Now, three more women who have spent years hiding their secret reveal the truth to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tired of leading a double life, these seven women confessed to Dr. Phil why they live in fear, shame and guilt. See what's happened. Now they go face-to-face with the men they've been deceiving.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A new desperate housewife is ready to spill her secret to Dr. Phil. Plus, he checks in with the other women and the secrets they could no longer hide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles the emotionally-charged topic of DNA tests. Recently making news, Spice Girl Mel B. had a DNA test done to prove Eddie Murphy was the father of their baby. Dr. Phil conducts a paternity test for one of his guests and gives you the chance to be there when he reads the results " but don't expect any brawling theatrics on Dr. Phil's stage!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These seven women say they live in fear every single day that their painful secrets will be discovered - secrets that could land them in jail, destroy their marriages, and even cost them their lives. They go face-to-face with Dr. Phil in a two-day workshop to finally stop living their masquerades and start revealing the truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s not just the title of a 90’s sitcom. Today Dr. Phil looks at kids leaving home – a healthy and sometimes welcome event in many parents’ lives, but one that can leave some with feelings of loss and emptiness. Hear how one mom cries herself to sleep each night in her daughter’s bed and calls her at least five times a day. You’ll also meet a widowed mother of eight who’s still paralyzed by grief since her youngest daughter left home four years ago. Join Dr. Phil as he helps these women learn to make themselves a priority and create a new role as mothers of adult children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: We all know someone who's been in a bad breakup, but Dr. Phil's guests say they've got ex-mates from hell!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: She’s suing McDonalds because her child got fat from their fast food. No, really! We’re serious! And in another “weighty” issue... can airlines make this passenger purchase 2 tickets because he can’t fit in a single chair? Plus, we’ll have one man who’s suing an airline for seating him next to an overwieght passenger. He claims he paid for a full seat and didn’t get to use all of it! Join us for “battles of the bulge.”

That's what happened to Jonnie and Dennis who dreamed about spending their lives together until they learned the disturbing truth. Is it legally and morally acceptable for them to stay married? Then, a daughter who's furious and feels betrayed because her 69-year-old father left her mother for a 27-year-old woman. And, should another guest get back together with her ex who served 23 years in prison for armed robbery and kidnapping? Find out what Dr. Phil thinks.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Women beware: Men are on the prowl! Some guys win your heart and dupe you for thousands of dollars, while other men learn the slick techniques of pick-up artists so they can get you in the sack! Go inside a classroom where single men are being taught The Mystery Method -- a step-by-step technique on how to meet, attract and date beautiful women. The founders say their method teaches guys to be more confident. When the students hit the bars, will The Mystery Method help them land a lady? What do the women think of their techniques? Then, meet Ross Jeffries, the self-proclaimed "Father of Seduction." He says he’s taught thousands of men to seduce women through language. Now he fears that he’s created monsters, because many of his followers are seducing woman through deception, and he says that’s exactly what The Mystery Method is all about. A heated debate ensues between Ross and the creators of The Mystery Method, Nick and Scott. Is Ross’ technique actually as benign as he claims? And, Victoria says she fell in love for the first time with a guy whom who she thought was the perfect man, until she says he scammed her out of $100,000. Did Victoria miss the warning signs? How can she pick up the pieces of her broken heart and move on? If you’re a lady looking for love but don't want to find heartache, you won’t want to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These guests say they can’t stop living the “Hollywoodlife".

programme.title: Top 5 Cold Cases: The Lie Detector
programme.desc: Jodie’s 15-year-old sister, Reesa, was brutally murdered on June 14, 1984. Jodie says she was only 13 years old and considered a prime suspect but the case went cold. It’s been over three decades, and she says the townspeople haven’t stopped gossiping and accusing her of murdering her only sibling. Will Jodie take Dr. Phil’s polygraph and end all the rumors? Then, Rachel accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt agrees to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal? Next, When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents say they believe their daughter was murdered. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Then, Dr. Phil delves into the mystery of 15-year-old Erica Parsons, who was last seen nearly two years ago but was only recently reported missing. Casey and Sandy -- the adoptive parents -- are offered a chance to take a polygraph test. Finally, 17-year-old Josh Young says his father, Joshua Gouker, tried to frame him in the 2011 murder of his stepbrother, Trey Zwicker -- only to later confess to the murder himself. Gouker’s cousin, Cassi, says she was asked to dispose of a weapon and bloody clothes. Can Dr. Phil get to the truth?

Her dad hires a menacing private eye to find them, Ginny's pregnant, her town doctor gives her horrible news, and Jack's mom has her own agenda. It seems that Jack and Ginny have grown up under a liar's moon. What will these sweethearts do?

programme.title: The Keeper of Lost Causes
programme.desc: Police inspector Carl Mørck and his assistant investigate a cold case involving a missing woman.

programme.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror

programme.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
programme.desc: Home is where the heart is, unless one lives in a house of hell; whether they're filled with specters or psychos, every house of hell pokes at illusions of comfort and safety.

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
programme.desc: Kansas law enforcement survey the aftermath of the seemingly unmotivated crime, while criminals Perry Smith and Richard Hickock go on the lam.

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
programme.desc: Detailing the resulting investigation and convictions of Perry Smith and Richard Hickock, along with the ensuing media coverage.

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
programme.desc: As Perry Smith and Richard Hickock face a death sentence, Truman Capote's coverage of the infamous case and his ensuing novel, "In Cold Blood," spawns the modern American True Crime genre.

programme.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle

programme.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle

programme.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
programme.desc: The world learns about the mass murder-suicide in Jonestown, orchestrated by cult leader Jim Jones; survivors try to piece their lives back together.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: A young man whose childhood was marked by tragedy learns of a relatively unknown serial killer, and finds himself thinking about unidentified victims; it isn't long before that pursuit becomes a full-time job and identifying victims an obsession.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: A young mother is found unresponsive in bed, and her cause of death is determined to be an accidental heroin overdose; but her family questions everything about the circumstances around her death, so they launch their own investigation.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective

programme.title: Behind the Monsters

programme.title: Behind the Monsters

programme.title: Behind the Monsters

programme.title: Behind the Monsters

programme.title: Behind the Monsters

programme.title: Behind the Monsters

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: A cattle baron awaits the return of his daughter from school and is surprised that his wife has returned to take their daughter away. He tries to keep the peace and do what is best for everyone.

programme.desc: Famous writer Mark Twain visits North Fork and Mark, who idolizes him, is hurt by his rudeness. Lucas intervenes and discovers the source of Twain's bitterness comes from personal tragedy. Later, both Marks become friends.

programme.desc: U.S. Marshal John Breaker and his deputy ride to a town held hostage by a ruthless gang as they transport a prisoner through the West. With the fate of a community at stake, they must decide if they will abandon the town or make a stand for justice.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: A criminal robs the Wells Fargo office in Hallelujah and plants evidence to frame Bret Maverick. After Bret is arrested and is sentenced to hang, the sheriff and a coroner make a deal to fake the hanging. Bret must find the money and clear his name.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: Cheyenne is on the run from the law after being falsely accused of murder. He boards a west-bound train for California, but a reverend's daughter interrupts his plans when she threatens to turn him in.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: Swindled by a charming woman, Cheyenne soon tracks her down as she drives her herd of cattle to Kansas. He joins the drive and finds out that one of the wranglers is a murderer.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark find a wounded man and bring him into North Fork to save his life. Lucas asks Simon Battle, a gunfighter-turned-doctor, to help the man. The wounded man's enemies have other plans in store.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A Chinese man named Wang Chi and his son, Wang Lee, come to North Fork to open a laundry service in town. Vince Fergus, a prejudiced man, bullies them but Micah, Lucas, and Milly try to convince them to stay. A fight between Fergus and Lucas ensues.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: When his best friend, Sheriff Clint Thorne (Jeff Fahey, Texas Rising, Justified), is brutally gunned down, former neighboring county sheriff, Alden Rockwell (Tom Wopat, The Dukes Of Hazzard, Longmire) is left with many questions and no answers. After the investigation stalls and his replacement, Sheriff Preston (Grant Goodeve, Eight is Enough, Dynasty) turns a blind eye, Alden takes the case into his own hands. Uncovering a web of crime, deceit, and corruption that spreads through two counties, Alden is caught in a deadly criminal network with no backup, no badge, and local diner owner, Maddie (Patricia Richardson, Home Improvement, The West Wing) as his only ally. Seeking justice at any cost, Alden must find out who's behind this criminal enterprise, even if some lines must be crossed.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After his wife leaves him, Deputy Marshal Heck Thomas throws himself into his work, hunting a gang of deadly bootleggers without regard for his own safety. But when he falls in love with a kind schoolteacher, Thomas suddenly has a lot more to lose.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: As a deputy in Phoenix, Enrique Garfias witnesses the lynching of prisoners by vigilantes. When he is later elected as the town's first marshal, he has a chance at redemption when he attempts to defend a gang of criminals from yet another angry mob.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: When frontiersman James Harrod founds Harrod's Town on Native American hunting grounds in Kentucky, he soon finds his new settlement under attack. His leadership is tested as he defends the first European settlement west of the Appalachian Mountains.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: It's The Cowboy Way's first road trip ever! Bubba, Cody and Booger cut loose and head north to enter a big chuck wagon race. But they quickly discover this race is not for amateurs. Loose wagon wheels, knee-deep mud and professional-grade competition raise both the stakes, and their concerns. Will the guys risk life and limb to race and win? And while the cowboys are away, a surprise shipment of cattle comes in days early and their wives must jump into action. But this drop off is anything but routine when Kaley and Misty discover one heifer has an infection that could threaten the entire herd.

programme.desc: Famous outlaw Jesse James convinces the James-Younger Gang to attempt its riskiest heist yet: a daring bank robbery in Northfield, Minnesota. But their well-laid plans are thwarted by sharp-eyed citizens intent on protecting their hard-earned money.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Once a feared gunfighter and sheriff, the legendary Bat Masterson is now working as a newspaperman. He heads west again to uncover the real story of Pearl Hart, the first woman to rob a stagecoach in the Old West. Masterson tracks down Pearl's partner-in-crime, Joe Boot, who shares every daring and surprising detail from his wild days with the notorious Bandit Queen. In a time when outlaws and gunslingers captured the fascination of the American public, Pearl Hart was living proof that in the Wild West a woman could be just as infamous as a man.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: English astronomers Charles Mason and Jeremiah Dixon brave deadly terrain and hostile Native Americans to resolve a border dispute in Colonial America. With science and courage, they survey their famous Mason-Dixon Line with pinpoint accuracy.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Booger goes back to school! On this episode of The Cowboy Way, the cowboys visit the Montgomery Stockyard to research cattle prices and Booger gets bitten by the auctioneering bug. Will his auctioneering classes pay off? Back at the ranch, the guys catch heat from a neighbor when their herd escapes into his field, and a rebellious heifer takes them on one heck of a ride. Misty's brother-in-law, Chip, stops by and gives Cody an earful that his feeding pasture has turned to dirt. And when the cattle stock market takes a nosedive, the cowboys' million-dollar business partner calls the gang into his office for a tough talk.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and Big Mike McComb head to a remote Mexican fishing village to help find buried Spanish treasure. But the man who invited them is nowhere to be seen. They find themselves in a dangerous situation with several people, including bandits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Daren is given control of the shop for a week. Darenʼs constant pestering and ribbing leads Mark to hand him the reigns of Graveyard Carz for a week. But instead of getting things done, Daren starts inventing new field trips and distractions for the crew, as well as becoming obsessed with getting his personal Dodge Challenger running again.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark receives an angry call from the owner of the 1970 Roadrunner, which leads to a mad rush to get the car finished in time. Meanwhile, Josh pushes the crew into committing to some New Years resolutions.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Frustrated by the crew's complaints that he spends all day being lazy in the front office. Mark is determined to prove to the guys that there is more to restoring a car than physical labor. Josh and Daren visit the crash site of the mangled orange 1971 'Cuda.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: As the team works to complete a multitude of cars, Mark stresses over the metal dipping of the very rare and valuable ʻ71 Cuda 440-6. Tensions are high and time is limited, is the GYC crew up to the pressure?

programme.desc: The ghouls get the remains back from the '71 440 Six Barrel, 4 Speed, Shaker Hood Phantom Cuda and determine if the car can be resurrected. A '69 Dodge Daytona Charger arrives ready to be brought back from the dead and Mark gets a 2011 SRT8 Dodge Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the N96 Air Grabber installed on the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car. It's started and is ready for final assembly. The owners of '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car visit to check on the restoration progress.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark is hired to restore the body, paint, and suspension of a '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The shop gets some needed upgrades and the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car is completed to OEM Specifications.

programme.desc: The '70 Sunroof Challenger is painted and ready for final assembly. The '69 Daytona Charger is disassembled and readied to be shipped to the media blasters. Mark and the Ghoulz head out to the junkyard to blow off some steam playing paintball.

programme.desc: Mark and the Ghoulz use their brand new Shop Crane to lower the body of the '71 Cuda 340 Triple Black 'Phantasm' Tribute car onto its restored suspension and its drive-train is assembled and installed.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car completely disassembled and off to the media blaster. Mark disassembles and restores the right-hand door to the 71' 440 Phantom Cuda. In addition, the headliner and vinyl top is installed in the 71 'Phantasm' Tribute car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.desc: The ghouls receives a '70 Barracuda Convertible to get a full restoration. Despite improbability, Mark straightens the fender for the '71 440 Phantom Cuda and the crew continues the restoration of the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls detail and assemble the suspension of the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The owners of the '70 Plymouth Superbird, in the queue for resurrection, visit the shop and Daren convinces the crew to throw a birthday party for Mark.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark takes some time for himself and leaves Daren in charge of the shop. The crew gets the newly painted panels installed on the '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car. And Mark discovers a chip on the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car and no one will own up to it.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The fuel and brake lines are installed in the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car. Daren quits and won't return until Mark begins the restoration of his '70 Plum Crazy Challenger. A phone-call from the Phantasm car owner forces Mark to make a promise he might not be able to keep.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds Buried Treasures in the form of two race cars that had been left almost completely untouched since the last time they were on a race track. One is found sitting in a barn with the other trapped in an old car hauler. Upon uncovering the cars, we find both have big stories to tell.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A journey to Indianapolis unveils the winning car of the 1955 Indy 500 sits on the roof of an auto mechanic shop. More than 50 years after it’s magic at the track, prominent Indy mechanic/owner Chris Paulsen begins to restore the car and Ray talks about the evolution of America’s illustrious Indy 500.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.
